verdict.rationale: Clerk documents custom Roles and 'fine-grained Permissions' scoped to Organizations, exposed in the session context, and it can gate agent tool calls against a caller's permissions and scopes. That goes somewhat beyond fixed roles, but it is still organization-level RBAC. Nothing in the evidence shows per-resource, relationship-based (ReBAC) or policy-based (ABAC/policy engine) authorization, and a community user notes roles are tied to organizations. Missing for 10: resource-level permission assignment, relationship-based authorization model, policy/attribute-based rules engine, independent hands-on corroboration.
